text:
Eli (PM): Flagging a weird edge: when you drag-to-reorder rules and immediately run the simulator, the simulator sometimes shows the previous ordering. Repro: create 3 rules, drag #3 to top, click Run Simulator. Seen in Firefox + Chrome.

Jorge (Eng-UX): I can reproduce. The simulator snapshot is triggered by a UI read that occasionally runs before our state commit. Likely a setState batching issue.

Rina (Design): In one of our sessions a user thought the reorder failed because the left list updated but the right simulator lagged. We should avoid that mental mismatch.

Sam (A11y): Keyboard reorder also problematic: after ctrl+up move, focus loses the row label. Screen reader reads old position sometimes.

Jorge (Eng-UX): Quick idea: instead of sampling DOM order, take order from the canonical store (we have ruleOrder in Context). Also add a tiny debounce for simulator capture (50-150ms) to wait for render.

Eli (PM): Prefer canonical store capture. Debounce ok as a fallback. Also we need a visible indicator so users know the simulator is updating.

Rina (Design): Proposed UI changes: 1) tiny inline shimmer in simulator panel with text "Applying latest changes..." 2) transient notice under the list "Order pending save" when changes are unsaved.

Sam (A11y): Shimmer must be accessible — provide aria-live="polite" text "Simulator updating to reflect latest rule order". For the pending state, ensure programmatic relation: aria-describedby on the list container.

Jorge (Eng-UX): I'll implement reading from Context + simulator loading state + aria-live. For keyboard focus jumping I'll try keeping a stable DOM id per rule and reuse focus after reorder (save previous focus index and restore).

Eli (PM): Copy tweak: current conflict validation says "Conflict" with no detail. Product wants: show which rule(s) conflict and which fields overlap. Eg: "Conflict: header X overlaps with header Y in rules A & B". Short, actionable.

Rina (Design): Example copy options: primary: "Rule conflict: 'Accept-Language' condition overlaps with rule 'EU traffic' — consider adding a country filter or lower priority." Secondary (short): "Overlapping conditions detected between A and B".

Sam (A11y): When showing conflict, set focus to the error summary and provide a link/button "Go to offending rule" that keyboard users can activate. Also ensure id mapping so the button moves focus into the card.

Jorge (Eng-UX): Backend validation returns conflict payload with ruleIds and fieldKeys. We can map those to friendly names and render the primary copy. Pseudocode: 
if (payload.conflicts.length) {
  const [a,b] = payload.conflicts[0];
  showBanner(`Rule conflict: ${a.name} overlaps on ${a.field} with ${b.name}`);
}

Eli (PM): Another UX ask: when dragging, users expect numbers to update immediately but our saved-index stays the same until commit. Could we show a faint "new index" next to the saved one during drag?

Rina (Design): Yes — show saved index as muted, show hovered/tentative index in accent color with tooltip "Will become #2 on save". Also show an "Apply order" button when there are unsaved ordering changes.

Jorge (Eng-UX): Implementation impact: auto-commit on drop would reduce confusion but increases write volume. Suggest feature flag: default to auto-commit for hosted tiers, keep manual for enterprise. Add an undo snackbar after auto-commit.

Sam (A11y): Undo snackbar must be reachable and have aria-live announce "Order saved. Undo". Keyboard focus should remain where it was or move predictably.

BotCI: CI queued for branch feature/routing-sim-fix — tests running.

Eli (PM): Can we also add a small unit/integration test that simulates reorder + immediate capture to prevent regressions?

Jorge (Eng-UX): Yes, will add Jest + RTL test that mocks Context update timing and verifies simulator receives latest order. Also add an accessibility e2e to exercise keyboard reorder and screenreader announcements.

Rina (Design): Minor color note: the simulator's highlight color is low contrast on dark mode. I'll upload token suggestions to the design system file.

Sam (A11y): Please run the contrast checker on the new tokens — need AA for non-text UI components as well.

Eli (PM): Plan: Jorge to open PR with the store-based capture + loading state + ARIA fixes. Rina will draft the conflict copy variants and tokens. Sam will provide a11y acceptance criteria. I'll create the sprint card and assign.

Jorge (Eng-UX): Draft PR: https://git.internal/redwood/routing-editor/pull/467 (WIP). Leaving notes for testers.

BotCI: Build 2155 succeeded, integration tests 30/31 passed, flaky test rerun scheduled.

Eli (PM): Thanks team — drop any extra edge cases here (filters + canary fallback + reorder) and I'll triage.
